message.content:
Artificial wreaths of textile materials fall under HTS 6702 (artificial flowers, foliage, and articles thereof). The subheadings are 6702.10 for plastics and 6702.90 for other materials. The flowers are polyester fabric on plastic stems, and the base is a vine (toad vine, a vegetable plaiting material).

Within 6702.90, 6702.90.35 covers "Other: of man-made fibers" and 6702.90.65 covers "Other" materials. Customs rulings on similar wreaths with polyester flowers and plastic stems have gone to 6702.90.65 or 6702.90.35. The essential character is the pink polyester flowers, so man-made fiber seems most likely, and the HTSUS for 6702.90.35 is "Of man-made fibers" at 6.6%.

The 10-digit statistical suffix is 6702.90.3500, a plausible choice. The alternative is 6702.10.4000 for plastics, which doesn't fit because the flowers are textile. I went with 6702.90.35.
